_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the StillWithYou extension's WhatsApp Web selectors.
This file is fetched at runtime from raw.githubusercontent.com. Editing it and
committing is how a WhatsApp DOM change gets fixed - no code edit, no extension
reload, no re-test. Live in roughly 5 minutes (GitHub's raw CDN cache).
The copy baked into extension/selectors.js is a FROZEN SNAPSHOT of this file and
is a last-resort fallback only. Do not maintain it by hand: change this file, then
re-sync the snapshot. Rationale and threat model: docs/phase5-remote-config.md.
Each target lists selectors in priority order, most specific first. The specific
ones key on attribute values WhatsApp owns and rotates; the last rung in each
chain is a structural/ARIA property that should only change in a real redesign.
A partial break therefore degrades to a broader match instead of to nothing.
sendButton is a HEALTH CANARY and is never bound to. Adding a selector here does
not and must not make the extension interact with WhatsApp's send.
note: v3 removes the broad div[role="textbox"][aria-label] rung added in v2. It matched WhatsApp's search box, and combined with the persisted self-tuning hint it silenced draft capture entirely on the real site. The code-level fix (a rejected match no longer ends the selector chain) makes the rung safe, but it was filler added to have something to push during a propagation test and earns no place in the chain on its own merits.

sendButton.description: the send button (health canary only - never bound)
